text:
Hana: Quick check  we're running a micro-spot award booth at the hiring mixer next Tue. need volunteers, a $100 float, and a simple sign-off flow.
Trevor: I can cover 56pm. do we have printed mini-cards or should volunteers use the app?
Sofia: Mini-cards please  less friction from folks who want to nominate in-person. I have 200 blank cards in Supplies-A.
Ivy: Finance note: any cash payouts need a petty cash slip and receipt photo. recommend float $100 max.
Hana: OK float $100. volunteers sign receipts and we take photos. peopleops-bot: Reminder: log event float in finance portal.
Trevor: Approval rule: manager initial on card required for any award >$75. volunteers should check initials before issuing.
Sofia: I'll print a 1-page checklist for the booth: card stack, marker, approval sticker sheet, float envelope, sign.
Ivy: For remote hires who want recognition, we can email an e-gift code same day. volunteers will record email on the back of the card.
Hana: Volunteers: 4:305:30 Sofia + Trevor, 5:306:30 Hana + floater. I'll post a signup in #all-hands.
peopleops-bot: Checklist created: /docs/events/mixer/mini-spot-booth-checklist.pdf
Trevor: Can comms make a small A3 sign "Nominate a Teammate"? I'll ping them.
Sofia: Adding a quiet corner option for folks who want private nominations.
Hana: Great. locking roster 24h before event. thanks team :sparkles:
